cards.t: Thailand SEC Approves Local Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs Starting October 16
cards.b: Thailand's SEC has finalized rules allowing local asset managers to launch spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, effective October 16.

per.BTC: Eligible for new local spot ETFs starting October 16.
per.ETH: Eligible for new local spot ETFs starting October 16.

cards.t: Solana Nears Final Upgrade to Halve Block Times to 200 Milliseconds
cards.b: Solana is completing a seven-week push to produce blocks twice as frequently, bringing block times down to 200 milliseconds.

per.SOL: Block times are being halved to 200 milliseconds.

cards.t: Sui Protocol Launches Hashi to Enable Institutional Bitcoin Lending
cards.b: Layer-1 blockchain Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol allowing holders to use bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network, debuting with $500 million in commitments.

per.SUI: Releasing Hashi protocol with $500M in commitments.
per.BTC: Can be utilized as collateral via Hashi without leaving the Bitcoin network.
